_note: Hyperparameters used for every reported result. Source of truth: code/models.py and code/data.py.

preprocessing.numeric: signed log transform sign(x)*log1p(|x|), then StandardScaler fitted on D_fit
preprocessing.TON_IoT: dropped: src_ip, dst_ip, src_port, dst_port, dns_query, ssl_subject, ssl_issuer, http_uri, http_user_agent, weird_name, weird_addl (plus labels); remaining string fields coerced to 0, so the models use the numeric fields

fusion.system_statistic: G = -1 - u for rule matches, else T_lambda - 1e-9*u, u = 0.5*s_s + 0.5*a/(1+a)
fusion.lambda_selection: inner leave-one-family-out on D_cal1 with a reduced LightGBM (100 trees, learning_rate 0.1)
fusion.threshold: alert iff k >= 1 and G(x) < G_(k) of D_cal2 benign flows, k = floor(alpha*(n+1))

baselines.XGBoost: XGBClassifier(n_estimators=300, max_depth=8, learning_rate=0.1, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.8, tree_method='hist')
baselines.Seq. hybrid (thesis): induced rules, then SMOTE + Random Forest (see code/models.py)
